text.en:
MALACAÑAN PALACE
BY THE PRESIDENT OF THE PHILIPPINES
[ EXECUTIVE ORDER NO. 204, May 13, 1939 ]
MAKING AN ADDITIONAL ALLOTMENT FROM THE APPROPRIATION FOR AID TO THE CITY OF
MANILA AUTHORIZED BY COMMONWEALTH ACT NO. 300
An additional allotment of eighty-eight thousand two hundred eighty pesos from the appropriation provided in
item H–IV–23, section one of Commonwealth Act Numbered Three hundred for “aid to the City of Manila for
the construction of public improvements, to be expended at the discretion of the Secretary of Public Works
and Communications, Commonwealth Act Numbered Two hundred forty-two,” in addition to the amount of
six hundred forty-four thousand nine hundred sixty pesos released in Executive Order Numbered One hundred
ninety, dated February twenty-eighth, nineteen hundred and thirty-nine, is hereby authorized.
The grand total of the funds, allotted up to this date from the appropriations provided in Commonwealth Act
Numbered Three hundred, including those authorized in Executive Orders Numbered One hundred ninety and
One hundred ninety-eight, current series, for the executive departments, should, therefore, amount to
thirty-eight million six hundred seventy-seven thousand seven hundred fifty pesos.
Done at the City of Manila, this thirtieth day of May, in the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and
thirty-nine, and of the Commonwealth of the Philippines, the fourth.
MANUEL L. QUEZON
President of the Philippines
By the President:
JORGE B. VARGAS
Secretary to the President
